name: Teen Volunteer at Dearborn Public Library
what_you_do: Teens help at the Dearborn Public Library. It takes teen applications now.
who_can_apply: Students who are at least 13 years old and enrolled in a Dearborn school. Volunteer spots are limited.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. The program page says the library is only taking teen volunteer applications at this time.
how_to_apply: Watch the orientation video. Then print the form and bring it to any Dearborn library.
notes: The library does not take court-ordered service. It cannot take all requests, so spots are few.
